question: A metal foam heat sink has a porosity ($\phi$) of 0.90. The solid skeleton is Copper ($(k_s = 400 \text{ W/m \cdot K})$) and the fluid is Air ($k_f = 0.026 \text{ W/m\cdot K}$). Calculate the absolute upper and lower theoretical bounds for the Effective Thermal Conductivity ($k_{e}$). Give your answer in W and two decimal places
